og_title: Storms Stir Beyond the Sea; The Gale Wind Appears
og_description: Han Li's desperate flight from the Gale Wind Beast reaches a climax as he races toward a teleportation formation with two terrifying foes on his tail.
twitter_title: Han Li faces a deadly three-way chase!
twitter_description: Han Li's Wind Spirit Restriction is killing him, and the Gale Wind Beast is closing in. Can he reach the teleportation formation in time?

lore_anchors.definition: An insidious energy lock planted by a superior cultivator, causing excruciating pain and restricting the victim's power; a classic Mortal Stream control mechanism used to ensure compliance or torment a captive.
A ninth-grade bird-type demon beast, known for its terrifying speed; its true form is a horrifying bird-fish hybrid that can outpace even lightning-based movement techniques.
When a high-level demon beast reverts to its original beast form to maximize the use of its natural天赋 abilities, often at the cost of some options but with a huge boost to its innate strengths.
A foundational mental cultivation technique that strengthens divine sense and grants resistance against soul attacks and mind-control techniques.
A cultivator's most vital life-force; burning or expelling it can grant a massive temporary boost in power, but at a permanent, irreversible cost to one's cultivation foundation and lifespan.
The supreme secret treasure of the Chaotic Star Sea, sealed in the Void Heaven Palace; the ultimate prize that drives the greed and desperation of even the most rational Nascent Soul cultivators.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the Wind Spirit Restriction?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is an energy lock planted by the demon Feng Xi inside Han Li's body, triggerable to cause excruciating pain and cripple his power, acting as a leash to ensure he cannot escape or fight back effectively.

He has been pursuing the legendary Void Heaven Cauldron, and Han Li is his only living link to it; his greed overrides his survival instincts, forcing him to risk a fight with a far more powerful demon beast.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is Han Li safe now that he's in the teleportation formation?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The formation is untested and could malfunction, sending him to a dangerous location, or worse, Feng Xi is right behind him and might interrupt the teleportation.
